question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE q4_2019_sales > 0 AND q4_2020_sales > 0
      AND (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(q4_2019_sales, 0) >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_desc, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT cps.prod_id,
           cps.calendar_quarter_desc,
           cps.product_sales,
           qt.total_sales,
           cps.product_sales * 1.0 / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM city_product_sales cps
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON cps.calendar_quarter_desc = qt.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_ranks AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           SUM(product_sales) as overall_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(product_sales) DESC) as ntile_rank
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_ranks
    WHERE ntile_rank = 1
),
top_product_shares AS (
    SELECT ps.prod_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN ps.share END) as share_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN ps.share END) as share_2020
    FROM product_shares ps
    JOIN top_products tp ON ps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
    GROUP BY ps.prod_id
)
SELECT tps.prod_id, p.prod_name, tps.share_2019, tps.share_2020, tps.share_2020 - tps.share_2019 as share_change
FROM top_product_shares tps
LEFT JOIN products p ON tps.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC
